verdict.rationale: Independent leaked Geekbench results show real single-core gains (M5 ~4133 vs M4 ~3748, ~10-12% higher) confirming actual single-thread improvement beyond marketing GHz claims, and community benchmarks (e.g., MicroGPT-C TPS test) also show M5 outperforming an older x86 chip. However, the evidence never benchmarks M5 against current-generation competitor chips to substantiate a 'leading' single-thread claim, and most Apple-provided material focuses on GPU/AI throughput rather than single-thread CPU speed. Missing for 10: head-to-head single-thread benchmarks vs competing modern CPUs (not just prior Apple gen), and first-party single-thread performance disclosures.
